newsitem.title: south korea: Port conditions update - South Korea - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - South Korea - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
BUSAN, Dec 9 - One hundred and ninety vessels in port, 67 at berth and 123 at anchorage. Usually two to three days delay due to berth congestion.
ULSAN - one hundred and twenty vessels in port, 80 at berth and 40 at anchorage. Usually one to two days delay due to berth congestion.
POHANG - thirty-five vessels in port, 34 at berth and one at anchorage. no delay.
INCHON - seventy-seven vessels in port, 58 at berth and 19 at anchorage. Usually 1-2 days delay due to berth congestion.
